evals.prompt: I added new Chinese UI prompts in an inventory warning modal. Scan the project, create i18n keys, sync translations to all non-zh locale files, and print a readable change list.
evals.expected_output: Detect new Chinese texts, propose valid keys, and update all target locale maps consistently.
expectations: All non-zh locale files are covered
No key naming conflict with existing schema keys
Placeholders and shortcut patterns are preserved

evals.prompt: Audit this repo for hardcoded user-facing Chinese literals in vue/ts/tsx/js files. Return file path, line, literal, and suggested i18n key for each issue.
evals.expected_output: Produce a complete hardcoded literal report with replacement key suggestions.
expectations: Each issue includes file line literal suggested_key fields
Already internationalized lines using $t are skipped

evals.prompt: Run a full i18n integrity validation against app.d.ts schema and locales/langs. Report keys missing in schema, missing translations, duplicate keys, and empty values.
evals.expected_output: Output a stable JSON validation report that is review-friendly.
expectations: Report includes missing_in_schema missing_translation duplicate_keys empty_values
Missing translation is shown for every non-zh locale file
Output uses consistent JSON field names
